name: Roshutsu no Megami-sama
source:
The protagonist, a college student, has just been dumped by his girlfriend… One day, he comes across a woman collapsed on the street… She’s wearing a strangely flimsy outfit. On top of that, her breasts and crotch are completely exposed—and there’s even a vibrator in her crotch!?

That’s right!! It turns out this woman is actually the wonderful “Goddess of Exhibitionism,” who says, “I actually have a fetish for showing off, but I’m too embarrassed to actually do it… So I’ll give girls like that the courage and drive to take action♪”!?

Of course, her energy comes from the “pleasure of exhibitionism,” but lately, the number of girls with exhibitionist tendencies has been dwindling, leaving her starving for energy. She’d made her way all the way to this town but finally ran out of strength…That was her situation.

For the time being, she decided to tag along with the protagonist, who was within sight, but when she happened to meet a neighbor named “Mizuki,” the Exhibitionist Goddess’s “Exhibitionism Sensor” went off like crazy!

That night… thanks to the goddess’s influence, she was caught completely naked and masturbating in the park at night by the protagonist, who had been following her—and she was shocked to find him there peeking!

With tears in her eyes, Mizuki came clean, but she was overjoyed to find the protagonist shared her hobby, and she even asked him to do some exhibitionist play with her! And so, the protagonist found himself in the role of “photographer, audience, and master.”

[From [url=https://www.getchu.com/item/227185/]Getchu[/url]]
translation:
刚被女友甩掉的大学生主人公，某天遇见一名昏倒在街头的女人。她衣着异常单薄，胸部与胯间完全暴露，胯间甚至有震动器！？

没错！！原来她就是出色的“露出女神”。她说：“我其实有展示身体的性癖，却害羞得无法付诸行动……所以我会给这样的女孩勇气与动力，让她们采取行动♪！”

她的能量来自“露出的快感”，但近来有露出倾向的女孩越来越少，让她濒临能量枯竭。她千里迢迢来到这个城镇，却终于耗尽力量……

暂时决定跟随主人公的她，碰巧遇见名为“美月”的邻居，露出女神的“露出传感器”顿时疯狂反应！

当夜……受女神影响，美月在公园全裸自慰，被跟踪她的主人公撞见；发现他偷窥时，她惊愕不已！

美月含泪坦白，却因为主人公也有同样爱好而欣喜若狂，甚至请他和自己进行露出游戏！于是主人公成了“摄影师、观众与主人”。
